label: EXISTS_2: World actual existential quantification
definition: At the selected world w a candidate satisfies both the independently supplied ex w predicate and P: ∃ x : E, ex w x ∧ P x. The constructor requires those two proofs for the same witness.
note: Analyst semantic interpretation, attribution deferred. E is a candidate domain, not an assertion of actuality. ex is primitive world-indexed existence; no structural law or identification with InAct at esse is assumed. Unit with empty ex separates the readings; full ex supplies a positive example. Property quantification, modal necessity and existence-to-esse are separate commitments.
